displayName: loop-sessions: 3 or more machines silent for a day

conditions.displayName: machines silent for over a day at or above 3 for 30 min

documentation.content:
Three or more enrolled laptops reported once and have not for a day. One or two is a weekend; three is a pattern, and the pattern that matters is a release whose daemon dies on start. The fleet-wide heartbeat (06b) covers the case where nobody reports at all.

Who and since when: `gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="loop-sessions" AND jsonPayload.message="fleet silent"' --freshness=15m --format='value(jsonPayload.email,jsonPayload.hours,jsonPayload.last_worst)'`. If they share an `agent_version` on their last `fleet condition` lines, that build is the suspect: check the release (README 7b) and the upgrade lag alert. Otherwise ping the people; a laptop that is asleep, off or without its daemon looks the same from here. Past 72 hours, `loop-sessions install` on the machine puts the daemon back.

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-silent
